import pytest
from subject import is_valid_onex_name


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_empty_string_returns_false():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("") is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("", lowercase_only=True) is False


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_valid_mixed_case_returns_true():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("ValidName123") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("valid_name_123") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("UPPERCASE") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("MiXeD_CaSe_123") is True


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_valid_lowercase_only_returns_true():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("lowercase_only", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("lowercase123", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("_underscore_", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("123numbers", lowercase_only=True) is True


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_invalid_characters_return_false():
    invalid_names = [
        "invalid-name",
        "invalid.name",
        "invalid name",
        "invalid@name",
        "invalid#name",
        "invalid$name",
        "invalid%name",
        "invalid^name",
        "invalid&name",
        "invalid*name",
        "invalid(name)",
        "invalid[name]",
        "invalid{name}",
        "invalid|name",
        "invalid\\name",
        "invalid/name",
        "invalid:name",
        "invalid;name",
        "invalid'name",
        'invalid"name',
        "invalid<name>",
        "invalid,name",
        "invalid?name",
        "invalid`name",
        "invalid~name",
        "invalid!name",
        "invalid=name",
        "invalid+name",
    ]
    for name in invalid_names:
        assert is_valid_onex_name(name) is False, f"Expected False for {name!r}"
        assert is_valid_onex_name(name, lowercase_only=True) is False, f"Expected False for {name!r} (lowercase_only)"


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_uppercase_with_lowercase_only_false():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("UpperCase", lowercase_only=True) is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("MiXeD", lowercase_only=True) is False
    assert is_valid_onex_name("UPPER", lowercase_only=True) is False


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_only_underscores_and_numbers():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("___") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("123") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("_1_2_3_") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("___", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("123", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("_1_2_3_", lowercase_only=True) is True


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_single_character():
    assert is_valid_onex_name("a") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("Z") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("_") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("9") is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("a", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("_", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("9", lowercase_only=True) is True
    assert is_valid_onex_name("Z", lowercase_only=True) is False
